verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs are a fair question for a recruiting SaaS platform, but the evidence never documents a way to run jobs or workflows on a recurring schedule. 'Custom agents for repeated workflows' are reusable agents invoked on demand, not time-based schedules. Webhooks react to events, and 'interview scheduling' means booking candidate interviews, so neither counts as a recurring job schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
